guardrails: Treat the current dirty desktop worktree as the authorized baseline; do not revert unrelated in-flight UI/editor work.
Keep changes slice-local and contract-first; avoid broad refactors across shell, editor, chat, and settings at the same time.
Run desktop Vitest from desktop/ or via npm --prefix desktop so repo-root collection does not pick up unrelated worktrees.
Require bounded slice-level tests after each IMPL task, then rerun a wider desktop passability sweep at the end.
